name: rxnaija-desktop
description: RxNaija for Windows — a desktop shell around the dashboard.
//scripts: start runs against production; start:local points at the Vite dev server so the shell can be worked on without deploying.
//devDependencies: cross-env because `VAR=value cmd` is not valid syntax in PowerShell or cmd.exe, and this is a Windows-targeted app that will be worked on from a Windows machine.

build.//files: Only the shell. The dashboard itself is loaded from the server, which is the point: a pharmacy never has a stale copy of the app, and shipping a fix does not mean shipping a new installer.

nsis.//: oneClick false so the installer is a normal wizard rather than a window that appears and vanishes — on an unsigned app, silent installation looks exactly like something a pharmacy should be worried about.
